question: Estimate the size of the NRI (Non-Resident Indian) consumer market for India-origin products and services.
idealClarificationQuestions: NRIs globally (32M) buying Indian brands, products, services? Yes.
Annual spend on Indian-origin goods + services + remittances? Provide categories.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Indian groceries + spices in foreign supermarkets (Patak, Tilda, MTR): ~$5B = ₹40,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Indian Bollywood movies in international theaters: ~$200M = ₹1,700 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total NRI-driven Indian economic activity (ex-remittance pure transfer): ~₹125,000 Cr / $15B annually.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: - Indian-language OTT subscriptions (Hotstar US, Sun NXT Global)
- Indian Bollywood movies in international theaters

calculationFlow: - Remittances back to India: ~$125B/year (~₹10.5 lakh Cr) — World Bank #1 recipient.
- Indian groceries + spices in foreign supermarkets (Patak, Tilda, MTR): ~$5B = ₹40,000 Cr.
- Indian-language OTT subscriptions (Hotstar US, Sun NXT Global): ~$300M = ₹2,500 Cr.
- Indian fashion/jewellery (Tanishq, Manyavar online + Indian boutiques abroad): ~$2B = ₹17,000 Cr.
- Indian Bollywood movies in international theaters: ~$200M = ₹1,700 Cr.
Total NRI-driven Indian economic activity (ex-remittance pure transfer): ~₹125,000 Cr / $15B annually.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total NRI-driven Indian economic activity (ex-remittance pure transfer): ~₹125,000 Cr / $15B annually.
